Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original fullbleed website scrollytelling artwork, a 16:9 wide landscape image.
Scene/backdrop: continuous near-black charcoal (#080b0e) background fills the entire scene.
Style/medium: extremely premium dimensional physical sculpture, expensive art photography and high-end CGI, crisp reflections, strong macro detail, bold vivid solid materials and convincing depth.
Composition/framing: sculptural mass dominates center and right two-thirds, centered near x70% y55%, extending and cropping beyond the right edge. Leftmost 35% remains predominantly dark, empty and calm to accommodate a white website headline later. Asymmetric organic composition.
Color palette: copper/orange and icy silver with acid chartreuse accents and deep dark shadows.
Constraints: artwork only. No website mockup, typography, text, logos, borders, fine wireframe, nodes, grids, charts, thin lines, fog, cloudy AI gradient blobs or evenly arranged geometry.
Subject: a gigantic asymmetrical contorted liquid-chrome fold: broad thick crumpled sheet with convex molten ridges, voluptuous solid curves and deep sharp creases, silver and copper reflections, and a few scattered oblong droplets.
Lighting/mood: dramatic strong directional key light revealing polished metallic surfaces, dark inner folds, bright copper reflections, icy silver ridges, tiny chartreuse accents. The sculptural mass feels massive and physical.
